title: E and Z where cis and trans fail
caption: In 1-bromo-1-chloropropene each carbon of the C=C carries two different groups, so cis/trans is ambiguous. By priority, Br beats Cl on one carbon and CH₃ beats H on the other: the two higher-priority groups together is Z, opposite is E.
description: Z isomer: Br and CH₃ on the same side of the double bond.
E isomer: Br and CH₃ on opposite sides.
